newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle market not well tested - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle market not well tested - USDA.

text.p: Steers and heifers were not well tested on a dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights), USDA said.
Dressed Basis Steers - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1300 lbs 109.00. Dressed Basis Heifers - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1075-1200 lbs 109.00; three loads mostly Choice 110.00.
Slaughter steers and heifers were not established. Demand narrow. Seller interest light at markedly lower bids.

Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Slaughter Steers - No confirmed sales. Slaughter Heifers - Load Select and Choice 2-3 1150 lbs 68.00. Confirmed - 1,000 Last Week - 7,300 Last Year - 1,400 Wk To Date - 3,000 Sm Pd Lst Wk- 17,300 Sm Pd Lst Yr- 3,500
